question: EMD_여수_상암동 위험도 알려줘
golden_typeql: match $s isa segment, has segment-id 'EMD_여수_상암동', has s-priority $sp, has state $st, has state-override-reason $r; get $sp, $st, $r;

question: EMD_나주_봉황면 상태가 어때?
golden_typeql: match $s isa segment, has segment-id 'EMD_나주_봉황면', has state $st, has s-priority $sp; get $st, $sp;

question: 지금 추론 시점이 언제야?
golden_typeql: match $r isa run-context, has reference-time $t, has status 'completed'; get $t; sort $t desc; limit 1;

question: 여수 상암동이 왜 PriorityPreWatering으로 격상됐어?
golden_typeql: match $s isa segment, has segment-id 'EMD_여수_상암동', has state $st, has state-override-reason $reason, has alert-level $al, has risk-grade $rg; get $st, $reason, $al, $rg;

question: MOCK 상태인 source 모두 알려줘
golden_typeql: match $s isa source, has availability-status 'MOCK', has source-id $id, has source-name $name; get $id, $name;

question: 광주에서 ImmediatePreWatering 단계인 segment 있어?
ontology_path: Segment WHERE admin-region LIKE '광주%' AND state='ImmediatePreWatering'
golden_typeql: match $s isa segment, has admin-region $r, has state 'ImmediatePreWatering', has segment-id $id; $r contains '광주'; get $id, $r;

question: 여수 상암동과 나주 봉황면 중 어디가 더 위험해?
golden_typeql: match $s isa segment, has segment-id $id, has s-priority $sp, has state $st; { $id == 'EMD_여수_상암동'; } or { $id == 'EMD_나주_봉황면'; }; get $id, $sp, $st;

question: EMD_장흥_유치면이 작업 불가인 이유?
golden_typeql: match $s isa segment, has segment-id 'EMD_장흥_유치면', has safety-class $sc, has state $st, has state-override-reason $r; get $sc, $st, $r;

question: REAL 상태인 source는 몇 개야?
golden_typeql: match $s isa source, has availability-status 'REAL'; get $s; count;

question: PriorityPreWatering 이상 상태인 segment를 점수 높은 순으로 알려줘
ontology_path: Segment WHERE state IN (Priority, Immediate) ORDER BY s-priority DESC
golden_typeql: match $s isa segment, has state $st, has segment-id $id, has s-priority $sp; { $st == 'PriorityPreWatering'; } or { $st == 'ImmediatePreWatering'; }; get $id, $st, $sp; sort $sp desc;

question: 현재 사용 중인 임계값(threshold) 설정 알려줘
golden_typeql: match $t isa threshold-set, has config-version 'v1', has metric-name $m, has th-low $low, has th-mid-low $ml, has th-mid-high $mh, has th-high $h; get $m, $low, $ml, $mh, $h;

question: 현재 NotActionable인 segment와 그 사유를 모두 알려줘
golden_typeql: match $s isa segment, has state 'NotActionable', has segment-id $id, has segment-name $name, has state-override-reason $reason, has safety-class $sc; get $id, $name, $reason, $sc;

question: 1990년 1월의 광주 동구 위험도 알려줘
golden_typeql: match $r isa run-context, has reference-time $t; $t < 2021-01-01T00:00:00; get $r;

question: S_priority 가중치 설정과 현재 PriorityPreWatering segment 모두 보여줘
ontology_path: weight-set v1 + Segment WHERE state='Priority' (두 쿼리 통합)
golden_typeql: match $w isa weight-set, has config-version 'v1', has w-official $wo, has w-exposure $we, has w-spread $ws, has w-action $wa, has w-time $wt; $s isa segment, has state 'PriorityPreWatering', has segment-id $id, has s-priority $sp; get $wo, $we, $ws, $wa, $wt, $id, $sp;
